asideNextText: Need test strings instead of names? The Random String Generator makes IDs and tokens.
asideText: Everything is generated locally in your browser with cryptographic randomness. Nothing is uploaded, stored, or tracked.

faq.a: The Random Picker picks from a list YOU paste. This generator invents new names from built-in first- and last-name lists — no input list needed.
faq.q: How is this different from the Random Picker?

faq.a: They are random combinations of common names. Any match with a real person is coincidence — the names are for fiction, testing, and placeholders, and carry no real person's data.

heroSubtitle: Full names for characters, mock users, and test data — generated from curated US name lists.
metaDescription: Generate random full names (first + last) from common US name lists — for story characters, test data and placeholders. Batch generation, free and private.
title: Random Name Generator — Fake Names for Stories & Testing | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: Never use generated names to impersonate anyone, create fake accounts, or misrepresent identity — they're for fiction and clearly-test data only.
The lists reflect common US names; they won't represent every culture or naming convention.
